verdict.rationale: The docs say sandboxes can run development servers and test applications 'with live previews'. They also mention isolated testing with 'live previews', which implies services inside the sandbox can be reached from outside. The pack never documents how to expose a port or that a public preview URL is issued, so this is only implied support. Missing for 10: explicit port-exposure configuration, a documented public preview URL mechanism (e.g. a domain-per-port API), access-control details, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
